name: flagged_tracks
note: The tours the corridor review flagged as wanting MORE track reduction - 'more track red', 'mer track redu', 'sterkere track data', 'enda mer track reduction'. A tour set only; it holds no config of its own, so the more_tracks_* profiles that extend it differ from production by exactly their own numbers. Widened from 27 to 30 on 2026-09-18 as the review went on: 180, 250 and 501 picked up the note, and 626 and 641 lost it. The two that lost it are KEPT - they are already built at every ceiling, dropping them would buy nothing, and every model has to cover the same tours or the panels stop being comparable. Trimmed on 2026-09-18: [250, 692, 1024, 1114] were deleted from tours.gpkg. lab._tours raises rather than skipping a missing fid, so leaving them here would have made every more_tracks stage refuse to run. 2026-09-18, later: [1118, 1124] deleted from tours.gpkg and dropped; [1137, 1138] picked up a 'more track red' note and were added. Note that 692, 1024 and 1114 also carry that note and are NOT here - they were deleted, and needs_fix keeps a record of a tour that is gone, so a note is not evidence the tour exists.
